_meta.description: Per-model scoring policy: thresholds, available seasons, shrinkage, standardization. Single source of truth for the About pages. Generated by Part A audit 2026-10-02.

stuff_plus.min_pitches_scoring_note: No minimum for scoring; all pitchers with valid pitches are scored. Shrinkage handles small samples.
stuff_plus.shrinkage_k_range: 0.4-2.8 pitches (estimated fresh each season from that season's data)
stuff_plus.standardization_population: all per-pitch raw predictions in that season (all pitch types pooled)
stuff_plus.scale: 100 = league average that season, 10 points = 1 standard deviation
stuff_plus.new_season_behavior: LightGBM missing-category branch (uncontrolled; retrain recommended annually)
stuff_plus.one_sentence: Grades every pitch's physical shape (velocity, movement, spin) relative to the league average that season, where 100 is average and 10 points is one standard deviation.

location_plus.scale: 100 = league average among qualified pitchers that season, 10 points = 1 standard deviation
location_plus.new_season_behavior: season category coerced to NaN (missing-category branch); retrain recommended annually
location_plus.one_sentence: Grades where each pitch was thrown relative to the strike zone, independent of what the pitch was, where 100 is average location quality that season.

tunneling_plus.note: The live scorer is analytics/tunneling_v2_model.py (promoted 2026-09-21). The router still uses /api/tunneling/v3/ URLs but serves v2 behind them.
tunneling_plus.min_pitches_scoring_note: Applied to RAW pitch count before lag-pair exclusion. Source: analytics/tunneling_v2_model.py:36 MIN_SEASON_PITCHES
tunneling_plus.requires_commit_point_note: Pitcher must have qualifying FF/SI/FC pitch to appear in the commit-point table. Absent pitchers produce no scored rows.
tunneling_plus.standardization_population: all pitchers who passed the 100-pitch filter that season
tunneling_plus.scale: 100 = league average among qualifying pitchers that season, 10 points = 1 standard deviation
tunneling_plus.new_season_behavior: season category coerced to NaN (missing-category branch); retrain recommended annually
tunneling_plus.geometry_validation_note: Corrected sequential same-at-bat test (Part A, 2026-09-21) found geometry features (commit/plate/shape distances) show no independent predictive signal for real whiff rates (z ≈ ±1.7). The model's predictive power comes from pitch-type sequencing (z = 18.6), not geometric measurement.
tunneling_plus.one_sentence: Grades how indistinguishable a pitcher's pitches look from each other at the hitter's commit point, using lag-context features over the previous six pitches, where 100 is average.

deception_plus.effective_training_seasons_note: arm_angle not available in Statcast before mid-2020 (~75% populated in 2020). Pitches without arm_angle are dropped by dropna. Effective training range is approximately 2021-2026. See NEEDS_DECISION.md ND-02.
deception_plus.available_scoring_seasons_note: REPORT_SEASON = 2026 hardcoded in api/routers/deception_report.py:25. No season selector wired up.
deception_plus.min_pitches_scoring_note: No explicit minimum pitch count. Pitcher must have at least one pitch with arm_angle populated AND a bio record (height_in, weight_lb). See NEEDS_DECISION.md ND-03.
deception_plus.features_note: height_in and weight_lb are time-invariant (current bio only, not season-specific). arm_angle, release_extension, release_pos_x_as, release_pos_z are per-pitch. Consistency features are per-(pitcher, season).
deception_plus.standardization_population: all per-pitch raw predictions for that season
deception_plus.scale: 100 = league average that season, 10 points = 1 standard deviation
deception_plus.new_season_behavior: season category uses model's own training category set; 2027 would be missing-category branch
deception_plus.known_limitation: arm_angle and release_pos_z correlate at r=0.79 league-wide; model partially captures pitcher identity rather than deception itself. height_in/weight_lb may allow model to recognize pitcher body types, which is an unresolved confound.
deception_plus.one_sentence: Grades a pitcher's body and release mechanics (arm angle, extension, release point consistency, height, weight) as a predictor of outcomes, independent of pitch shape, where 100 is average.
